local_profile: center spot plus five nearest spots, arithmetic mean
transform: CLR followed by within-patient median centering
training: up to 800 spots per patient with equal patient weight
dot_definition: same enrichment direction in >=3/4 patients and absolute median log2(Ro/e) >= 0.15
interpretation: Composition-defined spatial niches; functional immune labels require independent gene-program or ligand-receptor validation
